{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CejBJfWTioE9vQPS6Ynbs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01RZRbAkG5xCjzcGTo4LkzNt","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/floydwarshall_claude-opus-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","content":"// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA implementation of the Floyd-Warshall benchmark.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy\n//   * MPI     : the (padded) distance matrix is distributed by row-blocks over the\n//               ranks, one GPU per rank.  Every block-step the \"pivot\" row panel is\n//               broadcast from its owner to all other ranks.\n//   * CUDA    : the blocked Floyd-Warshall algorithm (dependent / partially\n//               dependent / independent phases) runs entirely on the GPU using\n//               shared-memory tiles.\n//   * OpenMP  : host side work (random initialization, packing, validation).\n//\n// The algorithm performs exactly the same sequence of relaxations as the classic\n// triple loop, therefore both the distance and the predecessor matrices are\n// bit-identical to the serial reference implementation.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Tile size used by the blocked GPU algorithm.  Small problems use a smaller\n// tile so that enough thread blocks are available to fill the device.\nconstexpr int TILE_SMALL = 32;\nconstexpr int TILE_LARGE = 64;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                                       \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                       \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__,    \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                      \\\n        }                                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Random number generation\n//\n// The reference implementation fills the matrix with a single sequential\n// rand_r() stream.  rand_r() is a plain 32 bit LCG advanced three times per\n// call, so the stream can be split for parallel generation by jumping the LCG\n// ahead.  Correctness of the replication is verified against the libc rand_r()\n// at run time; if it ever differs we fall back to the sequential stream.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace lcg {\nconstexpr unsigned int A = 1103515245u;\nconstexpr unsigned int C = 12345u;\n\n// Affine transform  s -> a*s + c  (mod 2^32)\nstruct Step {\n    unsigned int a;\n    unsigned int c;\n};\n\n// Apply f first, then g.\ninline Step combine(const Step f, const Step g) noexcept {\n    return Step{f.a * g.a, g.a * f.c + g.c};\n}\n\n// The transform that advances the state by n single LCG steps.\ninline Step advance(unsigned long long n) noexcept {\n    Step result{1u, 0u};\n    Step base{A, C};\n    while (n > 0) {\n        if (n & 1ull) {\n            result = combine(result, base);\n        }\n        base = combine(base, base);\n        n >>= 1;\n    }\n    return result;\n}\n\n// Bit-exact replica of glibc's rand_r().\ninline int next(unsigned int& seed) noexcept {\n    unsigned int s = seed;\n    s = s * A + C;\n    int result = static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 2048u);\n    s = s * A + C;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 1024u);\n    s = s * A + C;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 1024u);\n    seed = s;\n    return result;\n}\n\n// True if the replica matches the libc implementation.\ninline bool matchesLibc() noexcept {\n    unsigned int a = 42, b = 42;\n    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {\n        if (next(a) != rand_r(&b) || a != b) {\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n} // namespace lcg\n\n// Fill the local row slice [rowStart, rowStart+localRows) of the padded matrix.\n// Rows / columns outside of the original problem are padding: they are set to a\n// value large enough to never take part in a shortest path but small enough to\n// never overflow when two of them are added.\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(unsigned int* dist, const size_t numNodes, const size_t paddedNodes,\n                              const size_t rowStart, const size_t localRows,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    const size_t realRows = (rowStart < numNodes) ? std::min(localRows, numNodes - rowStart) : 0;\n\n    if (lcg::matchesLibc()) {\n        // Parallel generation: every row starts from a jumped-ahead LCG state.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < realRows; ++r) {\n            const size_t globalRow = rowStart + r;\n            const lcg::Step jump = lcg::advance(3ull * static_cast<unsigned long long>(globalRow) *\n                                                static_cast<unsigned long long>(numNodes));\n            unsigned int seed = jump.a * 42u + jump.c;\n            unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < numNodes; ++c) {\n                row[c] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * lcg::next(seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Fallback: reproduce the sequential stream and keep the local slice.\n        unsigned int seed = 42;\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < numNodes; ++r) {\n            const bool mine = (r >= rowStart) && (r < rowStart + localRows);\n            unsigned int* row = mine ? dist + (r - rowStart) * paddedNodes : nullptr;\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < numNodes; ++c) {\n                const unsigned int v =\n                    rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n                if (mine) {\n                    row[c] = v;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Padding columns of the real rows.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < realRows; ++r) {\n        unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n        for (size_t c = numNodes; c < paddedNodes; ++c) {\n            row[c] = INF;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Padding rows.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = realRows; r < localRows; ++r) {\n        unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < paddedNodes; ++c) {\n            row[c] = INF;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < localRows; ++r) {\n        const size_t globalRow = rowStart + r;\n        if (globalRow < paddedNodes) {\n            dist[r * paddedNodes + globalRow] = 0;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// The reference initializePathMatrix() assigns path[row][col] = row.\n__global__ void initializePathMatrixKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ path, const int paddedNodes,\n                                           const int rowStart, const int localRows) {\n    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localRows) * paddedNodes;\n    for (size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; p < total;\n         p += stride) {\n        path[p] = static_cast<unsigned int>(rowStart) + static_cast<unsigned int>(p / paddedNodes);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Blocked Floyd-Warshall GPU kernels.  Every thread block works on a B x B tile\n// and every thread owns a 2x2 sub-tile.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Phase 1: the pivot block (K,K) is relaxed against itself.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase1(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                         const int pitch, const int kb) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    __shared__ unsigned int sd[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n            sd[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sd[r][k] + sd[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sd[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 2a: the pivot row panel, blocks (K,j) for all j != K.\n// dist/path point at the first row of the pivot row block.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase2Row(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                            const int pitch, const int kb, const int kBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x;\n    if (j == kBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sPiv[B][B];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sCur[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int colBase = j * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch;\n            sPiv[r][c] = dist[base + kb + c];\n            cur[a][b] = dist[base + colBase + c];\n            cp[a][b] = path[base + colBase + c];\n            sCur[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sPiv[r][k] + sCur[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sCur[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + colBase + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 2b: the pivot column panel, blocks (i,K) for all locally owned i.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase2Col(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel, const int pitch, const int kb,\n                            const int skipRowBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    if (i == skipRowBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sPiv[B][B];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sCur[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int rowBase = i * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            sPiv[r][c] = panel[static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + kb + c];\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n            sCur[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sCur[r][k] + sPiv[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sCur[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 3: all remaining blocks (i,j), independent min-plus products of the\n// already updated pivot column block (i,K) and pivot row block (K,j).\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ __launch_bounds__((B / 2) * (B / 2)) void fwPhase3(\n    unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n    const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel, const int pitch, const int kb, const int kBlock,\n    const int skipRowBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x;\n    const int i = blockIdx.y;\n    if (j == kBlock || i == skipRowBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sA[B][B]; // block (i,K)\n    __shared__ unsigned int sB[B][B]; // block (K,j)\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int rowBase = i * B;\n    const int colBase = j * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            sA[r][c] = dist[static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + kb + c];\n            sB[r][c] = panel[static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + colBase + c];\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + colBase + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n#pragma unroll 8\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n        const unsigned int a0 = sA[ty][k];\n        const unsigned int a1 = sA[ty + H][k];\n        const unsigned int b0 = sB[k][tx];\n        const unsigned int b1 = sB[k][tx + H];\n        unsigned int nd;\n        nd = a0 + b0;\n        if (nd < cur[0][0]) { cur[0][0] = nd; cp[0][0] = kb + k; }\n        nd = a0 + b1;\n        if (nd < cur[0][1]) { cur[0][1] = nd; cp[0][1] = kb + k; }\n        nd = a1 + b0;\n        if (nd < cur[1][0]) { cur[1][0] = nd; cp[1][0] = kb + k; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + colBase + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Owner of a given pivot block.\nstatic inline int blockOwner(const int block, const int numBlocks, const int size) {\n    const int base = numBlocks / size;\n    const int rem = numBlocks % size;\n    const int big = (base + 1) * rem; Every block-step the \"pivot\" row panel is\n//               broadcast from its owner to all other ranks.\n//   * CUDA    : the blocked Floyd-Warshall algorithm (dependent / partially\n//               dependent / independent phases) runs entirely on the GPU using\n//               shared-memory tiles.\n//   * OpenMP  : host side work (random initialization, packing, validation).\n//\n// The algorithm performs exactly the same sequence of relaxations as the classic\n// triple loop, therefore both the distance and the predecessor matrices are\n// bit-identical to the serial reference implementation.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Tile size used by the blocked GPU algorithm.  Small problems use a smaller\n// tile so that enough thread blocks are available to fill the device.\nconstexpr int TILE_SMALL = 32;\nconstexpr int TILE_LARGE = 64;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                                       \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                       \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__,    \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                      \\\n        }                                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Random number generation\n//\n// The reference implementation fills the matrix with a single sequential\n// rand_r() stream.  rand_r() is a plain 32 bit LCG advanced three times per\n// call, so the stream can be split for parallel generation by jumping the LCG\n// ahead.  Correctness of the replication is verified against the libc rand_r()\n// at run time; if it ever differs we fall back to the sequential stream.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace lcg {\nconstexpr unsigned int A = 1103515245u;\nconstexpr unsigned int C = 12345u;\n\n// Affine transform  s -> a*s + c  (mod 2^32)\nstruct Step {\n    unsigned int a;\n    unsigned int c;\n};\n\n// Apply f first, then g.\ninline Step combine(const Step f, const Step g) noexcept {\n    return Step{f.a * g.a, g.a * f.c + g.c};\n}\n\n// The transform that advances the state by n single LCG steps.\ninline Step advance(unsigned long long n) noexcept {\n    Step result{1u, 0u};\n    Step base{A, C};\n    while (n > 0) {\n        if (n & 1ull) {\n            result = combine(result, base);\n        }\n        base = combine(base, base);\n        n >>= 1;\n    }\n    return result;\n}\n\n// Bit-exact replica of glibc's rand_r().\ninline int next(unsigned int& seed) noexcept {\n    unsigned int s = seed;\n    s = s * A + C;\n    int result = static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 2048u);\n    s = s * A + C;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 1024u);\n    s = s * A + C;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 1024u);\n    seed = s;\n    return result;\n}\n\n// True if the replica matches the libc implementation.\ninline bool matchesLibc() noexcept {\n    unsigned int a = 42, b = 42;\n    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {\n        if (next(a) != rand_r(&b) || a != b) {\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n} // namespace lcg\n\n// Fill the local row slice [rowStart, rowStart+localRows) of the padded matrix.\n// Rows / columns outside of the original problem are padding: they are set to a\n// value large enough to never take part in a shortest path but small enough to\n// never overflow when two of them are added.\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(unsigned int* dist, const size_t numNodes, const size_t paddedNodes,\n                              const size_t rowStart, const size_t localRows,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    const size_t realRows = (rowStart < numNodes) ? std::min(localRows, numNodes - rowStart) : 0;\n\n    if (lcg::matchesLibc()) {\n        // Parallel generation: every row starts from a jumped-ahead LCG state.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t r = 0; c < numNodes; ++c) {\n                row[c] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * lcg::next(seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Fallback: reproduce the sequential stream and keep the local slice.\n        unsigned int seed = 42;\n        for (size_t r = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch;\n            sPiv[r][c] = dist[base + kb + c];\n            cur[a][b] = dist[base + colBase + c];\n            cp[a][b] = path[base + colBase + c];\n            sCur[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\", \n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numNodes * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(numNodes * numNodes);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes);\n    \n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate operations per second\n    // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results_int(dist, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(dist, numNodes);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

b < 2; ++b) {\n            if (tx + b * H == k) {\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n                    const int r = ty + a * H;\n                    pivCol[r * B + k] = sd[r][k];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; (kBlock - firstBlock) : -1;\n            fwPhase2Col<B><<<myBlocks, threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, d_panel, d_colSnap, paddedNodes,\n                                                  kb, skip);\n            fwPhase3<B><<<dim3(numBlocks, myBlocks), threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, d_panel, d_colSnap,\n                                                                paddedNodes, kb, kBlock, skip);\n        }","originalFile":"// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA implementation of the Floyd-Warshall benchmark.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy\n//   * MPI     : the (padded) distance matrix is distributed by row-blocks over the\n//               ranks, one GPU per rank.  Every block-step the \"pivot\" row panel is\n//               broadcast from its owner to all other ranks.\n//   * CUDA    : the blocked Floyd-Warshall algorithm (dependent / partially\n//               dependent / independent phases) runs entirely on the GPU using\n//               shared-memory tiles.\n//   * OpenMP  : host side work (random initialization, packing, validation).\n//\n// The algorithm performs exactly the same sequence of relaxations as the classic\n// triple loop, therefore both the distance and the predecessor matrices are\n// bit-identical to the serial reference implementation.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Tile size used by the blocked GPU algorithm.  Small problems use a smaller\n// tile so that enough thread blocks are available to fill the device.\nconstexpr int TILE_SMALL = 32;\nconstexpr int TILE_LARGE = 64;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                                       \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                       \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__,    \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                      \\\n        }                                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Random number generation\n//\n// The reference implementation fills the matrix with a single sequential\n// rand_r() stream.  rand_r() is a plain 32 bit LCG advanced three times per\n// call, so the stream can be split for parallel generation by jumping the LCG\n// ahead.  Correctness of the replication is verified against the libc rand_r()\n// at run time; if it ever differs we fall back to the sequential stream.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace lcg {\nconstexpr unsigned int A = 1103515245u;\nconstexpr unsigned int C = 12345u;\n\n// Affine transform  s -> a*s + c  (mod 2^32)\nstruct Step {\n    unsigned int a;\n    unsigned int c;\n};\n\n// Apply f first, then g.\ninline Step combine(const Step f, const Step g) noexcept {\n    return Step{f.a * g.a, g.a * f.c + g.c};\n}\n\n// The transform that advances the state by n single LCG steps.\ninline Step advance(unsigned long long n) noexcept {\n    Step result{1u, 0u};\n    Step base{A, C};\n    while (n > 0) {\n        if (n & 1ull) {\n            result = combine(result, base);\n        }\n        base = combine(base, base);\n        n >>= 1;\n    }\n    return result;\n}\n\n// Bit-exact replica of glibc's rand_r().\ninline int next(unsigned int& seed) noexcept {\n    unsigned int s = seed;\n    s = s * A + C;\n    int result = static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 2048u);\n    s = s * A + C;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 1024u);\n    s = s * A + C;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 1024u);\n    seed = s;\n    return result;\n}\n\n// True if the replica matches the libc implementation.\ninline bool matchesLibc() noexcept {\n    unsigned int a = 42, b = 42;\n    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {\n        if (next(a) != rand_r(&b) || a != b) {\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n} // namespace lcg\n\n// Fill the local row slice [rowStart, rowStart+localRows) of the padded matrix.\n// Rows / columns outside of the original problem are padding: they are set to a\n// value large enough to never take part in a shortest path but small enough to\n// never overflow when two of them are added.\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(unsigned int* dist, const size_t numNodes, const size_t paddedNodes,\n                              const size_t rowStart, const size_t localRows,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    const size_t realRows = (rowStart < numNodes) ? std::min(localRows, numNodes - rowStart) : 0;\n\n    if (lcg::matchesLibc()) {\n        // Parallel generation: every row starts from a jumped-ahead LCG state.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < realRows; ++r) {\n            const size_t globalRow = rowStart + r;\n            const lcg::Step jump = lcg::advance(3ull * static_cast<unsigned long long>(globalRow) *\n                                                static_cast<unsigned long long>(numNodes));\n            unsigned int seed = jump.a * 42u + jump.c;\n            unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < numNodes; ++c) {\n                row[c] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * lcg::next(seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Fallback: reproduce the sequential stream and keep the local slice.\n        unsigned int seed = 42;\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < numNodes; ++r) {\n            const bool mine = (r >= rowStart) && (r < rowStart + localRows);\n            unsigned int* row = mine ? dist + (r - rowStart) * paddedNodes : nullptr;\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < numNodes; ++c) {\n                const unsigned int v =\n                    rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n                if (mine) {\n                    row[c] = v;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Padding columns of the real rows.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < realRows; ++r) {\n        unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n        for (size_t c = numNodes; c < paddedNodes; ++c) {\n            row[c] = INF;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Padding rows.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = realRows; r < localRows; ++r) {\n        unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < paddedNodes; ++c) {\n            row[c] = INF;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < localRows; ++r) {\n        const size_t globalRow = rowStart + r;\n        if (globalRow < paddedNodes) {\n            dist[r * paddedNodes + globalRow] = 0;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// The reference initializePathMatrix() assigns path[row][col] = row.\n__global__ void initializePathMatrixKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ path, const int paddedNodes,\n                                           const int rowStart, const int localRows) {\n    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localRows) * paddedNodes;\n    for (size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; p < total;\n         p += stride) {\n        path[p] = static_cast<unsigned int>(rowStart) + static_cast<unsigned int>(p / paddedNodes);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Blocked Floyd-Warshall GPU kernels.  Every thread block works on a B x B tile\n// and every thread owns a 2x2 sub-tile.\n//\n// To stay bit-identical to the serial triple loop the pivot data has to be used\n// exactly as it looked when the corresponding k iteration was executed: a naive\n// blocked implementation would relax against pivot entries that the serial code\n// only improves at a later k.  Therefore phase 1 and phase 2 snapshot the pivot\n// row / column at the very step where it is consumed, and the later phases work\n// on those snapshots.  The distance matrix stays identical either way, the\n// predecessor matrix does not.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Phase 1: the pivot block (K,K) is relaxed against itself.\n// Writes the row snapshot into the broadcast panel (columns of the pivot block)\n// and the column snapshot into the small pivot scratch buffer.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase1(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                         unsigned int* __restrict__ panel, unsigned int* __restrict__ pivCol,\n                         const int pitch, const int kb) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    __shared__ unsigned int sd[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n            sd[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n        // Snapshot row k / column k as seen by serial iteration kb + k.\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n            if (ty + a * H == k) {\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                    const int c = tx + b * H;\n                    panel[static_cast<size_t>(k) * pitch + kb + c] = sd[k][c];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            if (tx + b * H == k) {\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n                    const int r = ty + a * H;\n                    pivCol[r * B + k] = sd[r][k];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sd[r][k] + sd[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sd[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 2a: the pivot row panel, blocks (K,j) for all j != K.\n// dist/path point at the first row of the pivot row block.  The row snapshots\n// are written into the panel that is broadcast to all ranks.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase2Row(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                            unsigned int* __restrict__ panel,\n                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ pivCol, const int pitch, const int kb,\n                            const int kBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x;\n    if (j == kBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sPiv[B][B];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sCur[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int colBase = j * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch;\n            sPiv[r][c] = pivCol[r * B + c];\n            cur[a][b] = dist[base + colBase + c];\n            cp[a][b] = path[base + colBase + c];\n            sCur[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sPiv[r][k] + sCur[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sCur[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + colBase + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 2b: the pivot column panel, blocks (i,K) for all locally owned i.\n// The column snapshots are stored per row block for use by phase 3.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase2Col(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel,\n                            unsigned int* __restrict__ colSnap, const int pitch, const int kb,\n                            const int skipRowBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    if (i == skipRowBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sPiv[B][B];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sCur[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int rowBase = i * B;\n    unsigned int* snap = colSnap + static_cast<size_t>(i) * B * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            sPiv[r][c] = panel[static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + kb + c];\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n            sCur[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sCur[r][k] + sPiv[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sCur[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 3: all remaining blocks (i,j) - an independent min-plus product of the\n// pivot column snapshot (i,K) and the pivot row snapshot (K,j).\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ __launch_bounds__((B / 2) * (B / 2)) void fwPhase3(\n    unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n    const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel, const unsigned int* __restrict__ colSnap,\n    const int pitch, const int kb, const int kBlock, const int skipRowBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x;\n    const int i = blockIdx.y;\n    if (j == kBlock || i == skipRowBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sA[B][B]; // snapshot of block (i,K)\n    __shared__ unsigned int sB[B][B]; // snapshot of block (K,j)\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int rowBase = i * B;\n    const int colBase = j * B;\n    const unsigned int* snap = colSnap + static_cast<size_t>(i) * B * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            sA[r][c] = snap[r * B + c];\n            sB[r][c] = panel[static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + colBase + c];\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + colBase + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n#pragma unroll 8\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n        const unsigned int a0 = sA[ty][k];\n        const unsigned int a1 = sA[ty + H][k];\n        const unsigned int b0 = sB[k][tx];\n        const unsigned int b1 = sB[k][tx + H];\n        unsigned int nd;\n        nd = a0 + b0;\n        if (nd < cur[0][0]) { cur[0][0] = nd; cp[0][0] = kb + k; }\n        nd = a0 + b1;\n        if (nd < cur[0][1]) { cur[0][1] = nd; cp[0][1] = kb + k; }\n        nd = a1 + b0;\n        if (nd < cur[1][0]) { cur[1][0] = nd; cp[1][0] = kb + k; Every block-step the \"pivot\" row panel is\n//               broadcast from its owner to all other ranks.\n//   * CUDA    : the blocked Floyd-Warshall algorithm (dependent / partially\n//               dependent / independent phases) runs entirely on the GPU using\n//               shared-memory tiles.\n//   * OpenMP  : host side work (random initialization, packing, validation).\n//\n// The algorithm performs exactly the same sequence of relaxations as the classic\n// triple loop, therefore both the distance and the predecessor matrices are\n// bit-identical to the serial reference implementation.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Tile size used by the blocked GPU algorithm.  Small problems use a smaller\n// tile so that enough thread blocks are available to fill the device.\nconstexpr int TILE_SMALL = 32;\nconstexpr int TILE_LARGE = 64;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                                       \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                       \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__,    \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                      \\\n        }                                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Random number generation\n//\n// The reference implementation fills the matrix with a single sequential\n// rand_r() stream.  rand_r() is a plain 32 bit LCG advanced three times per\n// call, so the stream can be split for parallel generation by jumping the LCG\n// ahead.  Correctness of the replication is verified against the libc rand_r()\n// at run time; if it ever differs we fall back to the sequential stream.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace lcg {\nconstexpr unsigned int A = 1103515245u;\nconstexpr unsigned int C = 12345u;\n\n// Affine transform  s -> a*s + c  (mod 2^32)\nstruct Step {\n    unsigned int a;\n    unsigned int c;\n};\n\n// Apply f first, then g.\ninline Step combine(const Step f, const Step g) noexcept {\n    return Step{f.a * g.a, g.a * f.c + g.c};\n}\n\n// The transform that advances the state by n single LCG steps.\ninline Step advance(unsigned long long n) noexcept {\n    Step result{1u, 0u};\n    Step base{A, C};\n    while (n > 0) {\n        if (n & 1ull) {\n            result = combine(result, base);\n        }\n        base = combine(base, base);\n        n >>= 1;\n    }\n    return result;\n}\n\n// Bit-exact replica of glibc's rand_r().\ninline int next(unsigned int& seed) noexcept {\n    unsigned int s = seed;\n    s = s * A + C;\n    int result = static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 2048u);\n    s = s * A + C;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 1024u);\n    s = s * A + C;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= static_cast<int>((s / 65536u) % 1024u);\n    seed = s;\n    return result;\n}\n\n// True if the replica matches the libc implementation.\ninline bool matchesLibc() noexcept {\n    unsigned int a = 42, b = 42;\n    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {\n        if (next(a) != rand_r(&b) || a != b) {\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n} // namespace lcg\n\n// Fill the local row slice [rowStart, rowStart+localRows) of the padded matrix.\n// Rows / columns outside of the original problem are padding: they are set to a\n// value large enough to never take part in a shortest path but small enough to\n// never overflow when two of them are added.\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(unsigned int* dist, const size_t numNodes, const size_t paddedNodes,\n                              const size_t rowStart, const size_t localRows,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    const size_t realRows = (rowStart < numNodes) ? std::min(localRows, numNodes - rowStart) : 0;\n\n    if (lcg::matchesLibc()) {\n        // Parallel generation: every row starts from a jumped-ahead LCG state.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < realRows; ++r) {\n            const size_t globalRow = rowStart + r;\n            const lcg::Step jump = lcg::advance(3ull * static_cast<unsigned long long>(globalRow) *\n                                                static_cast<unsigned long long>(numNodes));\n            unsigned int seed = jump.a * 42u + jump.c;\n            unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < numNodes; ++c) {\n                row[c] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * lcg::next(seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Fallback: reproduce the sequential stream and keep the local slice.\n        unsigned int seed = 42;\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < numNodes; ++r) {\n            const bool mine = (r >= rowStart) && (r < rowStart + localRows);\n            unsigned int* row = mine ? dist + (r - rowStart) * paddedNodes : nullptr;\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < numNodes; ++c) {\n                const unsigned int v =\n                    rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n                if (mine) {\n                    row[c] = v;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Padding columns of the real rows.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < realRows; ++r) {\n        unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n        for (size_t c = numNodes; c < paddedNodes; ++c) {\n            row[c] = INF;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Padding rows.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = realRows; r < localRows; ++r) {\n        unsigned int* row = dist + r * paddedNodes;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < paddedNodes; ++c) {\n            row[c] = INF;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < localRows; ++r) {\n        const size_t globalRow = rowStart + r;\n        if (globalRow < paddedNodes) {\n            dist[r * paddedNodes + globalRow] = 0;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// The reference initializePathMatrix() assigns path[row][col] = row.\n__global__ void initializePathMatrixKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ path, const int paddedNodes,\n                                           const int rowStart, const int localRows) {\n    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(localRows) * paddedNodes;\n    for (size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; p < total;\n         p += stride) {\n        path[p] = static_cast<unsigned int>(rowStart) + static_cast<unsigned int>(p / paddedNodes);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Blocked Floyd-Warshall GPU kernels.  Every thread block works on a B x B tile\n// and every thread owns a 2x2 sub-tile.\n//\n// To stay bit-identical to the serial triple loop the pivot data has to be used\n// exactly as it looked when the corresponding k iteration was executed: a naive\n// blocked implementation would relax against pivot entries that the serial code\n// only improves at a later k.  Therefore phase 1 and phase 2 snapshot the pivot\n// row / column at the very step where it is consumed, and the later phases work\n// on those snapshots.  The distance matrix stays identical either way, the\n// predecessor matrix does not.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Phase 1: the pivot block (K,K) is relaxed against itself.\n// Writes the row snapshot into the broadcast panel (columns of the pivot block)\n// and the column snapshot into the small pivot scratch buffer.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase1(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                         unsigned int* __restrict__ panel, unsigned int* __restrict__ pivCol,\n                         const int pitch, const int kb) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    __shared__ unsigned int sd[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n            sd[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n        // Snapshot row k / column k as seen by serial iteration kb + k.\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n            if (ty + a * H == k) {\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                    const int c = tx + b * H;\n                    panel[static_cast<size_t>(k) * pitch + kb + c] = sd[k][c];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            if (tx + b * H == k) {\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n                    const int r = ty + a * H;\n                    pivCol[r * B + k] = sd[r][k];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sd[r][k] + sd[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sd[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 2a: the pivot row panel, blocks (K,j) for all j != K.\n// dist/path point at the first row of the pivot row block.  The row snapshots\n// are written into the panel that is broadcast to all ranks.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase2Row(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                            unsigned int* __restrict__ panel,\n                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ pivCol, const int pitch, const int kb,\n                            const int kBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x;\n    if (j == kBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sPiv[B][B];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sCur[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int colBase = j * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch;\n            sPiv[r][c] = pivCol[r * B + c];\n            cur[a][b] = dist[base + colBase + c];\n            cp[a][b] = path[base + colBase + c];\n            sCur[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n            if (ty + a * H == k) {\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                    const int c = tx + b * H;\n                    panel[static_cast<size_t>(k) * pitch + colBase + c] = sCur[k][c];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sPiv[r][k] + sCur[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sCur[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + colBase + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 2b: the pivot column panel, blocks (i,K) for all locally owned i.\n// The column snapshots are stored per row block for use by phase 3.\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ void fwPhase2Col(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                            const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel,\n                            unsigned int* __restrict__ colSnap, const int pitch, const int kb,\n                            const int skipRowBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    if (i == skipRowBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sPiv[B][B];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sCur[B][B];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int rowBase = i * B;\n    unsigned int* snap = colSnap + static_cast<size_t>(i) * B * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            sPiv[r][c] = panel[static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + kb + c];\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n            sCur[r][c] = cur[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            if (tx + b * H == k) {\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n                    const int r = ty + a * H;\n                    snap[r * B + k] = sCur[r][k];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n                const unsigned int nd = sCur[r][k] + sPiv[k][c];\n                if (nd < cur[a][b]) {\n                    cur[a][b] = nd;\n                    cp[a][b] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n                sCur[ty + a * H][tx + b * H] = cur[a][b];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + kb + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 3: all remaining blocks (i,j) - an independent min-plus product of the\n// pivot column snapshot (i,K) and the pivot row snapshot (K,j).\ntemplate <int B>\n__global__ __launch_bounds__((B / 2) * (B / 2)) void fwPhase3(\n    unsigned int* __restrict__ dist, unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n    const unsigned int* __restrict__ panel, const unsigned int* __restrict__ colSnap,\n    const int pitch, const int kb, const int kBlock, const int skipRowBlock) {\n    constexpr int H = B / 2;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x;\n    const int i = blockIdx.y;\n    if (j == kBlock || i == skipRowBlock) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sA[B][B]; // snapshot of block (i,K)\n    __shared__ unsigned int sB[B][B]; // snapshot of block (K,j)\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int rowBase = i * B;\n    const int colBase = j * B;\n    const unsigned int* snap = colSnap + static_cast<size_t>(i) * B * B;\n\n    unsigned int cur[2][2];\n    unsigned int cp[2][2];\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            sA[r][c] = snap[r * B + c];\n            sB[r][c] = panel[static_cast<size_t>(r) * pitch + colBase + c];\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + colBase + c;\n            cur[a][b] = dist[o];\n            cp[a][b] = path[o];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n#pragma unroll 8\n    for (int k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n        const unsigned int a0 = sA[ty][k];\n        const unsigned int a1 = sA[ty + H][k];\n        const unsigned int b0 = sB[k][tx];\n        const unsigned int b1 = sB[k][tx + H];\n        unsigned int nd;\n        nd = a0 + b0;\n        if (nd < cur[0][0]) { cur[0][0] = nd; cp[0][0] = kb + k; }\n        nd = a0 + b1;\n        if (nd < cur[0][1]) { cur[0][1] = nd; cp[0][1] = kb + k; }\n        nd = a1 + b0;\n        if (nd < cur[1][0]) { cur[1][0] = nd; cp[1][0] = kb + k; }\n        nd = a1 + b1;\n        if (nd < cur[1][1]) { cur[1][1] = nd; cp[1][1] = kb + k; }\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 2; ++a) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            const int r = ty + a * H, c = tx + b * H;\n            const size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(rowBase + r) * pitch + colBase + c;\n            dist[o] = cur[a][b];\n            path[o] = cp[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Owner of a given pivot block.\nstatic inline int blockOwner(const int block, const int numBlocks, const int size) {\n    const int base = numBlocks / size;\n    const int rem = numBlocks % size;\n    const int big = (base + 1) * rem; // blocks held by the first \"rem\" ranks\n    if (block < big) {\n        return block / (base + 1);\n    }\n    return rem + (block - big) / base;\n}\n\n// Distributed blocked Floyd-Warshall.  All matrices live on the device; the\n// pivot row panel is exchanged through pinned host memory.\ntemplate <int B>\nvoid floydWarshallDistributed(unsigned int* d_dist, unsigned int* d_path, unsigned int* d_panel,\n                              unsigned int* d_pivCol, unsigned int* d_colSnap,\n                              unsigned int* h_panel, const int paddedNodes, const int numBlocks,\n                              const int firstBlock, const int myBlocks, const int rank,\n                              const int size) {\n    const dim3 threads(B / 2, B / 2);\n    const size_t panelElems = static_cast<size_t>(B) * paddedNodes;\n\n    for (int kBlock = 0; kBlock < numBlocks; ++kBlock) {\n        const int kb = kBlock * B;\n        const int owner = blockOwner(kBlock, numBlocks, size);\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(kBlock - firstBlock) * B * paddedNodes;\n            unsigned int* rowsK = d_dist + off;\n            unsigned int* pathK = d_path + off;\n            fwPhase1<B><<<1, threads>>>(rowsK, pathK, d_panel, d_pivCol, paddedNodes, kb);\n            fwPhase2Row<B><<<numBlocks, threads>>>(rowsK, pathK, d_panel, d_pivCol, paddedNodes, kb,\n                                                   kBlock);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_panel, d_panel, panelElems * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        if (size > 1) {\n            MPI_Bcast(h_panel, static_cast<int>(panelElems), MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            if (rank != owner) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_panel, h_panel, panelElems * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (myBlocks > 0) {\n            const int skip = (rank == owner) ? (kBlock - firstBlock) : -1;\n            fwPhase2Col<B><<<myBlocks, threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, d_panel, d_colSnap, paddedNodes,\n                                                  kb, skip);\n            fwPhase3<B><<<dim3(numBlocks, myBlocks), threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, d_panel, d_colSnap,\n                                                                paddedNodes, kb, kBlock, skip);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    const size_t limit = std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10));\n    bool valid = true;\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < limit; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < limit; ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        valid = false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (numNodes == 0) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Number of nodes must be positive\\n\");\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    // One GPU per rank, assigned by the rank's position on its node.\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available on rank %d\\n\", rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    // Tile size: keep enough thread blocks in flight for small problems.\n    const int tile = (numNodes <= 1024) ? All matrices live on the device; the\n// pivot row panel is exchanged through pinned host memory.\ntemplate <int B>\nvoid floydWarshallDistributed(unsigned int* d_dist, unsigned int* d_path, unsigned int* d_panel,\n                              unsigned int* d_pivCol, unsigned int* d_colSnap,\n                              unsigned int* h_panel, const int paddedNodes, const int numBlocks,\n                              const int firstBlock, const int myBlocks, const int rank,\n                              const int size) {\n    const dim3 threads(B / 2, B / 2);\n    const size_t panelElems = static_cast<size_t>(B) * paddedNodes;\n\n    for (int kBlock = 0; kBlock < numBlocks; ++kBlock) {\n        const int kb = kBlock * B;\n        const int owner = blockOwner(kBlock, numBlocks, size);\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(kBlock - firstBlock) * B * paddedNodes;\n            unsigned int* rowsK = d_dist + off;\n            unsigned int* pathK = d_path + off;\n            fwPhase1<B><<<1, threads>>>(rowsK, pathK, d_panel, d_pivCol, paddedNodes, kb);\n            fwPhase2Row<B><<<numBlocks, threads>>>(rowsK, pathK, d_panel, d_pivCol, paddedNodes, kb,\n                                                   kBlock);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_panel, d_panel, panelElems * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        if (size > 1) {\n            MPI_Bcast(h_panel, static_cast<int>(panelElems), MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            if (rank != owner) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_panel, h_panel, panelElems * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (myBlocks > 0) {\n            const int skip = (rank == owner) ? (kBlock - firstBlock) : -1;\n            fwPhase2Col<B><<<myBlocks, threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, d_panel, d_colSnap, paddedNodes,\n                                                  kb, skip);\n            fwPhase3<B><<<dim3(numBlocks, myBlocks), threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, d_panel, d_colSnap,\n                                                                paddedNodes, kb, kBlock, skip);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n","numLines":50,"startLine":547,"totalLines":857}}}
